status.en: 139 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 26% fewer than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Kabul and Balochistan.
status.nb: 139 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 26 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Kabul og Balochistan.

summary.en: Armed incidents in Pakistan and Afghanistan have fallen 26% over the past week, with 139 reports concentrated in Islamabad, Kabul and Balochistan, and 20 of those covered by multiple outlets. The UCDP records 1,794 battle‑related deaths in 2024. Recent clashes include border fighting that left 12 militants and a soldier dead in Kurram, a joint operation killing a key TTP commander, and an attack on Riyadh airport blamed on Houthi forces that killed 12 and injured over 300. Pakistan has reiterated its commitment to Saudi security and warned India may fabricate a pretext for strike.
summary.nb: Væpnede hendelser i Pakistan og Afghanistan har falt med 26 % den siste uken, med 139 rapporter konsentrert i Islamabad, Kabul og Balochistan, og 20 av dem dekket av flere medier. UCDP registrerer 1 794 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024. Nylige sammenstøt inkluderer grensekamper som drepte 12 militante og en soldat i Kurram, en felles operasjon som tok en viktig TTP‑kommandør, og et angrep på Riyadh‑flyplass som Houthi‑styrker blir anklaget for, med 12 døde og over 300 sårede. Pakistan har gjentatt sin forpliktelse til Saudi‑sikkerhet og advart India om mulig fabrikasjon av en påskudd for angrep.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
